blocks.text:
Specifications:
 Color: Black
 Material: iron wire with black rustproof coating
 Package include: 2 x rose plant support
 Size: 23.2"H X 13.4"D

items.label: Supports the flowers
items.value: This rose support provides a stable support for roses, helps the flowers to grow and supports them into a beautiful bouquet shape. Ensures that the roses remain vertical, prevents the flowers from falling over due to gravity

items.label: Rustproof material
items.value: The plant support are made of sturdy iron wire with black rustproof coating, stand firmly, not easy to deform, prevent moisture and rust, resist the erosion of wind and rain, support and protect plants well

items.label: Easy to use
items.value: The detachable design does not require too much installation time, storage space, and does not require additional installation tools. The pointed design at the bottom of the frame allows for easy insertion into the ground, providing all-weather protection and support for your flowers

items.label: Package and size
items.value: You will receive 2 sets of peony support cage, the height measure about 23.2"after installation, the diameter of the large circle is 13.4", and the diameter of the small circle is 9.4", they will become one of your favorite garden helpers

items.label: Flower Protection
items.value: Especially in stormy weather or during transportation, rose flowers tend to topple over. The use of support frames can prevent this from happening and protect the flowers from damage effectively, perfect for outdoor vines vegetable gardens such as rose, peonies, tomato, cone flowers
